claim_boundaries.aabb_envelopes_only: The inherited projected rectangles bound retained axis-aligned boxes. They are not OBBs, exact meshes, silhouettes, segmentation masks, image footprints or object pixels.
claim_boundaries.no_measurement_or_endpoint_inference: No RGB artifact, crop/time mapping, labelability, human annotation, measurement feasibility, r0/rhat/r endpoint or generated/executed correspondence is authenticated. No A1-A9 result follows.
claim_boundaries.no_visibility_or_occlusion_inference: Envelope relation changes do not prove silhouette changes, visibility or occlusion. Camera-z relation changes do not identify a visible front object. RGB content, robot/static-scene surfaces and general occlusion are not analyzed.
claim_boundaries.science_and_release: No scientific acceptance threshold, fixture/camera qualification, current-state inference, gate promotion, dispatch/release authority or new behavioral evidence follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_confounding_and_effects: The three mapping pairs are availability-selected, not representative. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership. The arrow denotes comparison direction, not time, causation or motion. No layout, command, model, task-success, population or camera-ranking effect is estimated.

finding: Across 36 availability-selected original-to-reflected retained-geometry rows, projected AABB-envelope relation is unchanged for 35 and changes from positive-area overlap to positive separation for one. Camera-z interval relation is unchanged for 30 and changes between interval overlap and second-object-strictly-nearer for six. D01 and D02 are command-confounded; these descriptive transitions do not estimate an effect.

predicate_semantics.camera_depth_intervals: The inherited camera-z intervals use the same AABB corners. Relation transitions and reflected-minus-original positive-gap and interval-overlap deltas use exact stored floats. Camera z is not Euclidean range and depth order is not visibility or silhouette order.
predicate_semantics.command_boundary: D01 and D02 compare original-left against reflected-right mappings, so layout arm is command-confounded. P00 contains a shared left command, but its reflected mapping also contains a right-command member. No comparison isolates a layout, command, model or task effect.
predicate_semantics.comparison: For each availability-selected phase/layout-pair/model key, compare the pinned original and reflected reset-mapping rows with identical camera configuration hashes and object-pair order. This is a paired retained-geometry description, not a temporal transition or causal intervention.
predicate_semantics.projected_envelopes: The inherited rectangles are independent u/v minima and maxima of projected world.get_bbox-derived axis-aligned-box corners. Relation transitions and reflected-minus-original overlap-area and Euclidean rectangle-separation deltas use exact stored floats without epsilon or scientific threshold. No IoU is computed.
